edges.reason: _transfer reads isExcludedFromFees to decide fee and trading-pause exemption.
_transfer reads tradingOpened to gate transfers.
_transfer checks isBlacklistedUntil against block.timestamp.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to detect buys/sells.
_transfer reads the swapping flag to avoid nested swaps.
_transfer compares contract balance with swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer uses launchedAt for the antibot window and fee tiering.
_transfer uses liquidityFee in the fee split.
_transfer uses marketingFee in the fee split.
_transfer uses devFee in the fee split.
_transfer uses feeDenominator to scale the fee.
_transfer forwards marketing tokens to marketingWalletAddress.
_transfer forwards dev tokens to devWalletAddress.
_transfer indirectly uses the router when swapping accumulated fees.
addLiquidity calls the router stored in uniswapV2Router.
swapTokensForEth queries WETH and swaps through uniswapV2Router.
swapAndSendToFee is passed marketingWalletAddress as the fee address.
addLiquidity sends leftover ETH to marketingWalletAddress.
blacklistAddress uses blacklistTimeout to compute the expiry.
blacklistAddress writes into isBlacklistedUntil.
setLiquidityFee writes liquidityFee.
setMarketingFee writes marketingFee.
setDevFee writes devFee.
excludeFromFees writes isExcludedFromFees.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes isExcludedFromFees.
airdropDifferentNumberOfTokens reads and may set isExcludedFromFees.
airdropSameNumberOfTokens reads and may set isExcludedFromFees.
excludedFromFees returns the isExcludedFromFees entry.
updateUniswapV2Router reads the current router and writes a new one.
updateUniswapV2Router overwrites uniswapV2Pair with the newly created pair.
toggleTrading writes tradingOpened.
launch writes launchedAt.
launch sets tradingOpened to true.
_transfer relies on block.timestamp for blacklist expiry, antibot window and fee tiering.
launch stores block.timestamp as the launch time.
blacklistAddress computes the blacklist expiry from block.timestamp.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
msg.sender reaches _transfer through the inherited transfer/transferFrom entry points.
constructor calls _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair for the created pair.
constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, wallets and the contract.
airdropDifferentNumberOfTokens optionally calls excludeFromFees for the airdrop wallet.
airdropDifferentNumberOfTokens loops calling the internal _transfer.
airdropSameNumberOfTokens optionally calls excludeFromFees for the airdrop wallet.
airdropSameNumberOfTokens loops calling the internal _transfer.
updateUniswapV2Router marks the new pair as an AMM pair.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private helper.
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify with the liquidity share of tokens.
_transfer calls swapAndSendToFee for marketing and dev shares.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens for ETH.
swapAndLiquify adds the remaining tokens plus ETH as liquidity.
swapAndSendToFee swaps tokens for ETH before sending.
swapAndSendToFee forwards the swapped ETH to the fee address.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH function.
addLiquidity refunds leftover ETH to the marketing wallet.
swapTokensForEth performs the fee-on-transfer token swap on the router.
withdrawExcessBNB sends the contract balance to the given account.
withdrawOtherTokens transfers the arbitrary token balance out.
excludeFromFees updates the isExcludedFromFees mapping.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees batch-updates isExcludedFromFees.
blacklistAddress writes the blacklist expiry timestamp.
toggleTrading overwrites tradingOpened.
setLiquidityFee overwrites liquidityFee.
setMarketingFee overwrites marketingFee.
setDevFee overwrites devFee.
setBlacklistTimeout overwrites blacklistTimeout.
setMaxTxPermille recomputes maxTxAmount from totalSupply.
setMarketingWallet writes marketingWalletAddress.
setDevWallet writes devWalletAddress.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes automatedMarketMakerPairs.
updateUniswapV2Router overwrites uniswapV2Router.
from parameter drives the sender side of _transfer.
to parameter drives the recipient side of _transfer.
amount parameter drives fee and balance math in _transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount swapped in swapAndSendToFee.
feeAddress parameter receives the swapped ETH.
feeAddress is the destination of the low-level ETH send.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
newAddress parameter becomes the new router address.
account parameter is written into the fee-exclusion mapping.
airdropWallet is the source of the airdrop transfers.
airdropRecipients array bounds the airdrop loop.
airdropAmounts array supplies the transfer amounts.
pair parameter is validated and stored as an AMM pair.
value parameter sets the AMM pair flag.
account parameter is the blacklisted address.
value parameter decides whether to apply or clear the blacklist.
maxTxPermille parameter scales the max transaction amount.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and supplied to addLiquidityETH.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as msg.value to the router.
_token parameter selects the arbitrary ERC20 to rescue.
_account parameter receives the rescued tokens.
_account is the destination of the external token transfer.
_account parameter receives the withdrawn ETH.
_account is the destination of the low-level ETH send.
_transfer stores balanceOf(address(this)) into contractTokenBalance.
_transfer sums the three fees into totalFees.
_transfer derives the takeFee boolean.
_transfer computes fees via amount * totalFees / feeDenominator, a multiplication/division prone to rounding or overflow.
swapAndSendToFee captures the ETH returned by the swap.
The swapped ETH balance is sent to the fee address.
swapAndLiquify stores the ETH obtained from swapping half the tokens.
swapAndLiquify computes half of the token amount.
swapAndLiquify computes the remaining token half.
addLiquidity uses the swapped ETH balance as msg.value.
swapTokensForEth snapshots the contract ETH balance before swapping.
swapTokensForEth builds the token/WETH path array.
The path array is passed to the external router swap call.
withdrawExcessBNB reads address(this).balance into contractBNBBalance.
withdrawOtherTokens reads the contract token balance.
The read token balance is the amount passed to the external transfer.
The router swap performs external calls while _transfer is not protected by a reentrancy guard, allowing reentrant fee swaps.
Low-level ETH send to the fee address can re-enter the transfer/swap flow before state is settled.
Low-level ETH send to the marketing wallet can re-enter the fee-swap state machine.
Router addLiquidityETH calls external pair contracts during liquidity provisioning.
Sending the full contract ETH balance lets the receiver re-enter withdrawExcessBNB.
Calling transfer on an arbitrary attacker-supplied token can re-enter withdrawOtherTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the _transfer body.
The to parameter only exists to feed the _transfer body.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the _transfer fee math.
The tokens parameter is internal to swapAndSendToFee.
feeAddress flows directly into the low-level ETH send.
tokenAmount is only used inside swapTokensForEth.
newAddress is only used to reconfigure the router.
account is the key written by excludeFromFees.
airdropWallet is the local source of the airdrop loop.
The recipients array only bounds the airdrop loop.
The amounts array only supplies loop amounts.
pair is only used to configure the AMM pair mapping.
value is only used to configure the AMM pair mapping.
account is the key written by blacklistAddress.
value decides the blacklist duration written.
maxTxPermille is only used to recompute maxTxAmount.
tokenAmount is only approved and supplied to the router.
ethAmount becomes the msg.value of the router liquidity call.
_token only selects the ERC20 instance to drain.
_account is the destination of the external token transfer.
_account is the destination of the ETH send.
The balance snapshot is local to _transfer.
totalFees is a local sum used only in _transfer.
takeFee is a local branch flag in _transfer.
fees is the local arithmetic result used by _transfer.
The swapped balance is immediately sent to the fee address.
The swapped ETH balance is local to swapAndLiquify.
half is a local split used only in swapAndLiquify.
otherHalf is a local split used only in swapAndLiquify.
initialBalance is a local bookkeeping value in swapTokensForEth.
The path array is consumed by the external router swap call.
The contract balance is the value forwarded by the ETH send.
The token balance is the amount forwarded by the external transfer.
